## I6 per candidate (E3 [Venus]) [computed, exact]

## I8 per distinct 6D content (E1, E2 [Venus]) [computed, exact]

Per positive-chirality 6D Weyl field (sign Gamma7): (d/5760)(tr R^4 + (5/4)(tr R^2)^2) - (1/96) tr R^2 tr F^2 + (1/24) tr F^4 [standard: Alvarez-Gaume-Witten 1984; Green-Schwarz-West 1985], 2pi factors dropped. r4 = tr R^4, r2 = tr R^2. tr_3 F^4 = t3^2/2 and tr_2 F^4 = t2^2/2 [identity, E2], so only tr R^4 is irreducible. Random-matrix check of tr F^4 = (tr F^2)^2/2 (largest relative error over 20 draws): su(2) 1.475e-16, su(3) 2.024e-16, su(4) 2.180e-01 (fails for su(4), as expected).
